description.value:
“Kill anything that moves,” is the marketing line for this anti-material rifle. A more apt one would be, “Kill anything you can actually hit.” Meant as a competitor to Techtronika’s SPT-32 Grad, the Kraber is an inelegant amalgamation of a precision and anti-material rifle. Its high-penetration .57-cal rounds turn most flesh to mush, but its bulky handling, lacking compatibility, and unreliable accuracy have relegated it to a very select clientele — those with the gear or skill to make the Kraber’s faults disappear. Make no mistake, though: One solid hit from it is enough to send you six feet under.

Cost: 2,000eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Exotic Sniper Rifle • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Anti-Material Rifle

Damage: 7d6, Drop Lowest • Capacity: 4 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Bipod, Precision Stock, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope • Mods: None

Special Features: All Attacks with this weapon suffer a -2 penalty to their Attack Check. After this weapon is fired, an Action is required to work its bolt before it can be fired again. Whenever this weapon would ablate armor, it ablates 2 additional points of SP (3 SP Total). Drawing this weapon requires an Action, even while it is easily accessible, and while the user is Prone or the weapon is Mounted on a Bipod, if they fire the weapon and roll a 2 on their Attack Check, they gain a +1 bonus to their Check, or a +2 if they instead roll a 1 [Precision Stock]. Incompatible with Folding Structure. Requires BODY 6+ to wield unless Mounted.

Range: Anti-Material Rifle
Pre-installed: Bipod, Precision Stock, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Damage is 7d6, dropping the lowest die. CPR 0.92.4 can't drop dice automatically, so drop them by hand from the damage roll.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Exotic weapon.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
